question: Should OpenClaw replace or augment the scalar `plugins.slots.memory` contract with purpose-specific memory role slots now, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 be the landing path after rebase and proof refresh?
rationale: The request changes public config, plugin SDK expectations, runtime loading, diagnostics, doctor migration, docs, and multi-agent behavior, which requires maintainer product/API intent rather than an autonomous bug-fix decision.

options.title: Sponsor Role-Slot Review
options.body: Treat the linked role-slot PR as the candidate path, require a clean rebase plus fresh upgrade/runtime proof, and settle the role taxonomy before merge.

options.title: Narrow To One Subproblem
options.body: Keep the issue open but split or defer non-recall roles such as dreaming, capture, and user modeling until each has a smaller API contract.

options.title: Reject Core Role Slots For Now
options.body: Keep current one-slot memory architecture and direct additional memory composition to plugin-specific sidecars or ClawHub packages until the memory default converges.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Role-Slot Review
recommendation.body: Treat the linked role-slot PR as the candidate path, require a clean rebase plus fresh upgrade/runtime proof, and settle the role taxonomy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent visible history across memory/plugin docs and memory runtime behavior, and this choice is primarily a product/API contract decision.
